title: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. translated_title: 基于持续学习的人-智能体协商中的个性化情感感知
translated_abstract: 与人类进行协商的自利智能体应当能够解读非语言表达并据此调整自身行为。然而，通用的面部情感模型在不同个体和情境之间性能会下降，存在泛化差距。我们提出了一种情感自适应的协商策略，其中融合了基于“想象”的持续学习面部表情识别方法（CLIFER），以实时地实现个性化的效价-唤醒度感知。差分反馈机制将效价-唤醒度方向与强度的变化转化为智能体目标效用的调整。一种异步架构使CLIFER能够在实时交互过程中于后台进行更新。在一项平衡设计的被试内实验中，66名参与者与人形机器人进行协商，结果表明：启用持续学习的智能体相比FaceChannel基线取得了显著更高的个体效用，并引发了参与者更高的让步率。持续学习条件产生了显著的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CLIFER——一种基于持续学习与想象机制的面部表情识别方法，使人形机器人在与人类协商中实时个性化地感知情绪并动态调整协商策略，相比基线显著提升了个体协商效用。
